c74object.name: el.vdp~
c74object.digest: Variable delay line with internal feedback, filtering, and buffer export
c74object.description:
el.vdp~ is a variable delay line with internal feedback that overcomes the minimum vector-size delay limit imposed by tapin~/tapout~. Because feedback is calculated sample-by-sample inside the DSP loop, delay times can be modulated down to fractions of a millisecond without delay constraints. It features an integrated one-pole lowpass filter in the feedback loop (filter, coef) for Karplus-Strong plucked string synthesis, an infinite hold looper (inf_hold), linear delay interpolation (interpolate), feedback runaway protection (protect), and offline export of the delay line contents directly into a named mono buffer~ (copy_to_buffer).
Inlets
Inlet 1 [Left Inlet] (signal / messages): Audio signal to be delayed, and control message inlet (filter, coef, protect, inf_hold, interpolate, clear, copy_to_buffer, show).
Inlet 2 (signal / float): Delay time in milliseconds (clamped between 0.0 and maximum-delay).
Inlet 3 [Right Inlet] (signal / float): Feedback gain coefficient (-1.0 to 1.0).
Outlets
Outlet 1 (signal): Delayed audio output signal.

inlet.description: Audio signal to be delayed, as well as operational commands (filter, coef, protect, inf_hold, copy_to_buffer, etc.).
Delay time in milliseconds. Accepts float messages or audio-rate modulation signals.
Feedback gain multiplier. Accepts float messages or audio-rate modulation signals.

outlet.description: The processed variable delay audio output signal.

objarg.name: maximum-delay
objarg.description: The maximum delay buffer size in milliseconds (default: 50.0 ms, range: 1.0 to 3,600,000 ms).

objarg.name: initial-delay
objarg.description: Initial delay time in milliseconds (default: 0.0 ms).

objarg.name: feedback
objarg.description: Initial feedback gain multiplier (default: 0.5, range: -1.0 to 1.0).

method.name: clear
method.description: Zeroes out the entire internal delay line memory.

method.name: coef
method.description: Sets the internal one-pole lowpass filter coefficient when filter is active (default: 0.5).

method.name: copy_to_buffer
method.digest: Export delay line to a buffer
method.description: Copies the current contents of the internal delay line into a named single-channel (mono) buffer~. The destination buffer must have at least as many sample frames as the delay line length.

method.name: filter
method.description: When set to 1, enables an internal one-pole lowpass filter in the feedback loop to simulate acoustic damping (Karplus-Strong plucked string synthesis). When set to 0 (default), filtering is bypassed.

method.name: float
method.description: Float sent to inlet 2 sets delay time in milliseconds. Float sent to inlet 3 sets feedback gain.

method.name: inf_hold
method.description: When set to 1, freezes the current contents of the delay line in an infinite loop without recording new input. When set to 0 (default), normal delay recording resumes.

method.name: int
method.description: Converted to float to set delay time or feedback.

method.name: interpolate
method.description: When set to 1 (default), linear interpolation is used for fractional delay reads. When set to 0, nearest-sample truncation is used.

method.name: protect
method.description: When set to 1, automatically clamps feedback gain within ±0.99 to prevent runaway overload. When set to 0 (default), feedback is unconstrained.

method.name: show
method.description: Prints the current feedback gain and delay time in milliseconds to the Max Console.

method.name: signal
method.description: Signal arriving at inlet 1 is the audio to be delayed. Signals arriving at inlets 2 and 3 continuously modulate delay time and feedback at audio rate.
